comparison_rule: Each case defines canonical logical fields. Every listed reference serializes those fields through its own TL engine; raw_hex is the byte string all implementations must produce for the identical input. The Rust test in crates/tonutils-tl/src/tl/cross_sdk.rs asserts that tonutils-rs serialization equals raw_hex and that reference bytes roundtrip through our decoders byte-for-byte. Field-to-field semantic relations (signatures, derived ids) are intentionally not checked; these fixtures compare wire layout only.
